context: Repair Reverso Codex sync so a process launched with CODEX_HOME writes its generated Ollama profile and catalog under the active Codex home.
root_causes: The stale active catalog contained only qwen3.8:27b-mlx while the gateway exposed both models.
evidence: CODEX_HOME regression test was red before the fix and green after it.
uv run --project . python -m pytest tests/unit/test_codex_sync.py -q passed 138 tests.
The active CODEX_HOME convergence apply changed provider-ollama and updated its catalog to include glm-5.2:cloud and qwen3.8:27b-mlx.
solutions: Resolve the default Codex config from CODEX_HOME at module import time.
Keep the existing config-parent catalog resolution and add one focused regression test.
acceptance_criteria: A subprocess with CODEX_HOME set resolves the generated config and catalog under that home.
The default ~/.codex behavior remains unchanged when CODEX_HOME is unset.
The focused and full codex_sync unit tests pass.
The active CODEX_HOME Ollama catalog exposes both live models.
legacy_risk_reason: Cross-home profile routing affects active client files, so a subprocess import test is used to cover the environment boundary.
